decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line close to the firm’s core charcuterie business, in a growing industry with hiring and apparent organisational slack, it is likely to meet strategic aspirations and be retained.

This organic poultry snack fits the firm’s existing capabilities and stated expansion of organic offerings, so absent any visible sign of underperformance the firm would more likely keep it than reallocate resources away from it.

Because this premium salami snack line is closely related to the established assortment and the firm offers a broad range while the market context is supportive, management would likely continue it unless results clearly fall short of aspirations.
